title: Project / open-source entry
description: data/resume/projects/*.yaml and data/resume/open_source/*.yaml — one file per item, both rendered through the same project_details partial. If `repo` is set, star/fork counts are fetched from the GitHub API at build time; if `packagist` is set, download counts are fetched from Packagist.

end.description: End date, unquoted YYYY-MM-DD. Omit if ongoing.

language.description: Primary language, shown as a badge. Typically used for standalone projects rather than open-source packages.

repo.description: GitHub "owner/repo" slug, e.g. IonBazan/composer-diff. Also makes the item link to the repo and shows star/fork badges.

packagist.description: Full Packagist package URL, e.g. https://packagist.org/packages/ion-bazan/composer-diff. Adds a download-count badge (fetched from <url>.json).

keywords.description: Shown as badges alongside language/star/download counts.

order.description: Sort order within the section, ascending.
